faq.q: What song opens the GTA 6 Netflix Extended Look?
faq.a: "Pop Bottles," a 2007 single by Birdman featuring Lil Wayne, opens the music in the Extended Look. It plays from roughly 0:06 to 0:45 as Jason and Lucia approach a drug den.

faq.q: Who performs Pop Bottles in GTA 6?
faq.a: Birdman, featuring Lil Wayne. The 2007 single was catalogued by GameRant with a timestamp based on direct viewing of the Netflix Extended Look.

faq.q: What scene plays during Pop Bottles in GTA 6?
faq.a: Jason and Lucia approach a drug den and are stopped by people near the entrance, right as the Netflix Extended Look opens its music with this track.

faq.q: How was the footage in the GTA 6 Netflix Extended Look made?
faq.a: Rockstar produced the 26 minute gameplay preview with Netflix from PlayStation 5 footage, released August 27, 2026, according to GameRant's report.

faq.q: Is Pop Bottles confirmed on an official GTA 6 soundtrack list?
faq.a: This record only documents the song opening the Netflix Extended Look footage. Whether Rockstar has separately credited it on an official soundtrack list has not been stated here.
